instruments.notes: Bracketed zero cost collar with one of two refiners (unnamed). Berry participates in 100% of upside above $15.50/bbl trigger after a $3/bbl payment; trigger based on heavy oil postings. Floor/ceiling strikes not explicitly labelled in text, so left null. Contract expires at year-end 2000; start date not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Of this 6,500 B/D, Berry participates on 5,000 B/D above $15.50/bbl and
on 1,500 B/D above $17.50/bbl.  These price triggers are based on
heavy oil postings and both contracts expire at year-end 2000.
